allowed_use: Fill span plus per-256-wide-K-round issue service of the one compiled program that the Qwen3-30B-A3B TP2 decode qkv and o_proj projections select on this deployment. Coefficients are fitted only on NON-PRODUCTION output widths N=3584/4096/4608; the production widths N=2048 and N=2560 were held out and used solely as an independent check.
applicability_warning: DOES NOT APPLY TO THE CANONICAL qwen3-30b-a3b tp2_ep2 DATASET. The raw device-launch projection that dataset was built from shows every mcBLAS launch in it is tn_64x32x256_2m1n8k_256t (plus a tn_128x64x256_2m1n8k split-K form), not the tn_64x32x256_4m1n8k_256t this reference measures. The 4m1n8k program is what the CURRENT container selects for those shapes; the capture ran an older build that selects 2m1n8k. This reference remains a valid measurement of 4m1n8k and must not be used to price that dataset.

cta_versus_bytes.statement: The output-width term is weight bytes, not per-CTA dispatch. Raising M from 32 to 35 doubles the launched CTA count (ceil(M/32) M-tiles) at identical weight bytes and does not change the measured time, so a per-CTA cost is falsified.

forbidden_use: Any other compiled program -- in particular tn_64x32x256_2m1n8k_256t (selected at N=1920/3072), tn_256x32x128_2m1n8k_256t (M=2), tn_16x16x64_1m1n1k_256t (N=128) and tn_64x48x256_4m1n8k_256t (M=48) -- and not a per-shape correction. Also invalid at N>=5120, where the per-round weight footprint leaves the issue-limited regime.

independent_cross_check.statement: An independent earlier sweep of the same program at N=2560 measured k_round_service_us = 1.5607; this fit, from three different and disjoint output widths, gives 1.5386 (1.4% apart). The per-round service is therefore a property of the compiled program rather than of the shape, which is what licenses extrapolating it to the production widths.

l2_residency_control.statement: The single-buffer probe replays one weight back to back and could in principle retain part of it in the 8.39 MB L2. Re-measuring with eight rotating weight buffers (working sets 67-151 MB) changes every cell by at most 3.5% and with no systematic sign, so these numbers are the DRAM-streaming regime that serving runs.

observed_canonical_grids_2m1n8k.note: From the canonical capture's own raw projection; grid/block only.

provenance.identity_tool: mcTracer, one invocation per swept shape
